# FLX-3626: the placeholders of a consumer query do not match its parameters

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Each placeholder is named (:name, $name, @name or %(name)s, by dialect) and takes the value the query's parameters give it, as a string, a whole number or a boolean written into the tree and never into the text. A placeholder with no value, a positional placeholder (?, %s, $1), a parameter that no placeholder uses, and a placeholder in a view are refused.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3626
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
